_comment: Art prompts for No. 20, written 2026-10-26. Higgsfield's Private workspace still has 0.25 credits (balance checked this run), so the pictures are made another way or the draft ships text-only. Each prompt is one subject, close in, in action, a likeable face where there is one (sokno-ear-art skill; Andy 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-19). The people differ in hair, view and hand action so the week does not read as one picture repeated. Run each through generate_image (model recraft-v4-1, model_type standard, colors [#171512,#F3E8D2,#7FAEA3,#A94A34], background_color #F3E8D2, aspect 1:1) or the ChatGPT app with the prefix 'Generate an image, 1:1 aspect ratio.' Then scripts/optimize-image.sh <in> public/assets/spots/<file> 900 88, check each at 120 px, set story.image and layout (feature imageTop, the rest alternating imageLeft/imageRight), and swap the scanner placeholders.
suffix: Predominantly black ink linework with stipple dots and cross-hatch shading, slight engraving texture, warm cream paper background, restrained accents in muted teal and rust red. Charming and specific, not generic. Hand-drawn local newspaper engraving, not a photograph, not flat vector. No text or letters anywhere.

halloween-pub-crawl.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a smiling woman in a witch's hat, seen three-quarter from her left, holding up a small folded paper passport booklet with one hand while a rubber stamp in another person's hand comes down on it, cropped from her shoulders up with the booklet large in the frame. Red hair under the hat brim, a grin, the stamp mid-press, a little ink star already on the page. No wide view, no street, no background scenery.

puckers-boos-and-brews.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a ping-pong ball in mid-air about to land in a cup set inside a carved jack-o'-lantern, extreme close-up, the pumpkin's grinning face filling the lower two thirds of the frame and the ball caught an inch above the cup rim. Candle glow inside the pumpkin, a hand blurred at the edge having just thrown. No room, no crowd, no background scenery.

wax-museum-fbn.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a hand lowering a record needle onto a spinning vinyl LP whose label shows a tiny cartoon monster face, extreme close-up of the turntable platter filling the frame, grooves catching light, a cocktail glass with a cherry at the frame edge. No room, no people beyond the hand, no background scenery.

freaks-ball-fbn.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a grinning DJ in a devil-horn headband and sequined jacket, seen head-on from the chest up, both hands on the mixer, headphones half off one ear, confetti frozen in the air around him. Short dark curly hair, a wide delighted smile, lights as stipple sparkles. No crowd, no room, no background scenery.

808-90s-rave.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: two raised hands with glow-stick bracelets stacked up both forearms, fingers spread, a whistle on a cord between them, cropped tight from the elbows up with the hands filling the frame, the glow sticks in teal and rust accents. No crowd, no stage, no background scenery.

808-bear-grillz.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a person in a full shaggy bear costume head, mouth open in a roar, wearing big over-ear headphones and pointing one paw straight at the viewer, cropped from the chest up and filling the frame. Fur drawn in dense hatching, teeth bright, a little sweat on the costume's brow. No stage, no crowd, no background scenery.

pink-is-punk-halloweemo.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a young man with a long side-swept emo fringe over one eye, black eyeliner, a studded wristband, shouting lyrics with both fists up, seen in full side profile facing left, cropped from the chest up. A tiny skeleton pin on his collar, a bat barrette in the fringe. No crowd, no room, no background scenery.

belltower-hiween.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a laughing woman in dramatic goth makeup, black lipstick and a lace choker, platinum-blonde hair, belting into a karaoke microphone held in her left hand, seen three-quarter from her right, cropped from the ribs up, a little disco-ball sparkle on her cheek. No room, no screen, no background scenery.

dia-de-los-muertos-pink-cactus.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a serene woman with half her face painted as a catrina sugar skull, flower crown of marigolds, eyes closed and smiling while a fine brush in another hand finishes a petal on her cheek, head-on, cropped from the collarbones up and filling the frame. Dark hair in braids, the painted half in fine stipple. No room, no background scenery.

drop-dead-drag-hiwire.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a drag queen in a towering teased wig and a rhinestone collar winking at the viewer with one gloved hand raised in a tiny wave, head-on, cropped from the shoulders up, lashes long, lips in rust red, a bat-shaped earring. No stage, no crowd, no background scenery.

trailhead-jake-smith-trio.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a bass player's hands on the neck of an upright bass, one hand walking the strings and the other plucking, extreme close-up of the instrument's upper body filling the frame, a string buzzing, the scroll at the top edge. No stage, no patio, no background scenery.

trailhead-four-legged-dog.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a happy hound dog in a tiny cowboy hat and bandana sitting right beside a guitarist's boot and the lower body of an acoustic guitar being strummed, the dog's face large and close, tongue out, ears up, cropped tight so the dog and the guitar fill the frame. No patio, no crowd, no background scenery.

trailhead-mt-olive.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a trumpet player's cheeks puffed, eyes squeezed shut, seen in full side profile facing right, the trumpet's bell huge and flaring toward the frame edge, cropped from the shoulders up. Grey hair, a flat cap, a little spit valve detail. No stage, no patio, no background scenery.

kerns-hodown.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a laughing woman in a cowboy hat and a cheap vampire cape riding a mechanical bull, one hand gripping the handle and the other thrown up high, hat flying off, seen three-quarter from her left and cropped from the bull's head up so she fills the frame. Auburn ponytail, fringe on the sleeve, the bull's horns in the foreground. No lawn, no crowd, no background scenery.

starlight-paddle.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a kayaker seen from the front at water level, a headlamp beam glowing on her forehead, both hands on the paddle as one blade lifts out of dark water trailing drips, a few stars as stipple dots above her shoulders, cropped from the kayak's bow up so she and the paddle fill the frame. Dark braid, a life vest, a calm smile. No riverbank, no horizon, no wide view.

playscape-storytime-bats.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a toddler in a bat-wing hoodie, hood up with little felt ears, reaching both hands toward a plush bat puppet held open-winged by an adult's hand, the child's delighted face large and head-on, cropped from the chest up. Round cheeks, two bottom teeth, the puppet's wings spanning the top of the frame. No playground, no crowd, no background scenery.

playing-possum.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a young opossum held gently in two gloved hands, its pink nose and whiskers toward the viewer, round dark eyes, pale face and grey body fur in fine hatching, its tail curled around one wrist, extreme close-up filling the frame. The naturalist's green sleeve at the edge. No room, no crowd, no background scenery.

renew-in-nature.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a hand circling a felt mallet around the rim of a brass singing bowl, extreme close-up with the bowl filling the lower frame and sound drawn as faint concentric rings, a fallen oak leaf resting on the mat beside it. No room, no people beyond the hand, no background scenery.

specials-board.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a margarita glass with a sugar rim and a lime wheel, a tiny plastic spider ring hooked over the rim as a Halloween garnish, the drink filling the frame edge to edge, a hand just setting it down with condensation drops caught mid-slide. No bar, no river, no background scenery.
